hook: I paid every premium. Now the insurer has **rejected my claim.**
hook_q: Claim rejected. What can I do?

slides.title: First, write to **your insurer.**
slides.body: Give your complaint in writing to the insurer's complaints or grievance redressal cell, along with the necessary supporting documents.

slides.title: No fix in two weeks? **Go to IRDAI.**
slides.note: only the insured or claimant can file

slides.title: The **Insurance Ombudsman** can step in.
slides.body: You can complain to the Ombudsman about full or partial rejection of a claim, delay in settling a claim, or disputes over premium.

timeline.text: Insurer rejects it, doesn't reply, or you're not satisfied
File with the Ombudsman, unless a court, consumer forum or arbitrator has the matter (pending or decided)

slides.title: File **online** or by email.
slides.body: A complaint can be made by email or online through the website of the Council for Insurance Ombudsmen, cioins.co.in, where you can also track its status.

slides.title: The award **binds the insurer.**
list: Award within 3 months of getting all requirements
The award is binding on the insurer

sources: Insurance Ombudsman Rules, 2017 (as amended till 09.11.2023) – Rules 13, 14, 17
caption:
Insurance claim rejected? You don't have to accept it quietly. 👇

1️⃣ First, complain to your insurer in writing, with documents
2️⃣ Not resolved in two weeks? Escalate to IRDAI on Bima Bharosa, by email or on 155255
3️⃣ The Insurance Ombudsman hears complaints on claim rejection, claim delay and premium disputes
4️⃣ Go to the Ombudsman if the insurer rejects you, doesn't reply in a month, or you're not satisfied, within one year
5️⃣ File online on cioins.co.in or by email
6️⃣ The award can give up to Rs 50 lakh and is binding on the insurer

Source: Insurance Ombudsman Rules, 2017 (Rules 13, 14, 17); IRDAI
